_doc: Copy to policies/<your-project>.json and select with --project <name>. All keys are optional; unknown keys are ignored by this version.

deny._doc: Deny is absolute: denied capabilities never enter bundles, even for required lanes.

require_context.why: Load prior project decisions before acting.
require_context._doc: Choices resolve in order, each with its own type. required=true raises when none resolve; false skips silently.

prefer._doc: Regex on the task text; matching adds the chosen capabilities to the lane with a score boost. Add "first": true to keep only the first choice that is added (a preferred capability, then its fallback).

_enable_routes_doc: Opt-in built-in demo routes (they reference skills that may not exist on your machine; disabled lanes degrade silently).

output_lane.why: Apply the external-facing voice pass last.
output_lane._doc: Fires only when the task matches external-facing keywords (email, deck, publish, ...).
